ReleaseNotes: - Successful updates now reopen VBox Tray Manager with an Update Complete tab showing the installed version and release notes.
- Failed updates that are successfully rolled back now reopen with an Update Failed tab explaining what happened and confirming the restored version.
- Post-update result tabs are temporary, closable, automatically selected, and appear at the end of the main tab bar.
- Failed updates now provide clearer feedback when the previous version has been restored successfully.
- The updater displays the failure reason and rollback status before restarting the restored Manager.
- The restored Manager suppresses automatic update rediscovery for that process, preventing an unsuccessful update from immediately appearing to repeat.
- Update Failed provides quick actions to view the updater log, retry the update, or download the full installer.
- Start Minimized to Tray is temporarily overridden when an update result needs attention.
- The saved Start Minimized preference is never changed, and normal startup behavior resumes on the next launch.
- Retry Update now uses the normal VBox Tray Manager update discovery and notification path.
- Post-update release notes use the existing release-note parser and presentation behavior.
